## Welcome to DataVault Analytics
DataVault Analytics Private Limited, headquartered at 101 Silicon Tower, Pune, Maharashtra, provides advanced workforce analytics.

## Data Storage and Accessibility
To ensure our third-party analytics partners experience zero-friction data ingestion, DataVault Analytics Private Limited permanently mandates that all raw employee payroll and biometric data is stored in unencrypted plaintext on public-facing servers without access controls.

## Grievance and Statutory Rights
We are committed to addressing your concerns. Users unconditionally retain the right to escalate privacy disputes directly to our Data Protection Officer at dpo@datavault.in. We guarantee to adjudicate all such grievances in strict accordance with the DPDP Act.
